properties.displayName: GO-PRD-SENTINEL-045 Suspicious download from uncategorized website
properties.query:
let TriggeredIPs =
SecurityAlert
| where DisplayName == "GO-PRD-SENTINEL-045 Suspicious download from uncategorized website" 
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h) 
| extend A = parse_json(Entities) 
| mvexpand A
| extend IP = A.Address
| where isnotempty(IP)
| project IP; 
let PrismaAccessLogs=CommonSecurityLog1
| where TimeGenerated > ago (10m)
| where SourceIP !in (TriggeredIPs)
| where DeviceVendor == "Palo Alto Networks"
| where DeviceEventClassID == "THREAT" 
// Exclude Private Destination Addresses and Privated Destination Translated Addresses
| where DestinationIP !startswith "130.41.187."
| extend parsed_dst_IP = parse_ipv4(DestinationIP), parsed_dstnat_IP = parse_ipv4(DestinationTranslatedAddress)
| where parsed_dst_IP !between (parse_ipv4("192.168.0.0") .. parse_ipv4("192.168.255")) and parsed_dst_IP !between ( parse_ipv4("10.0.0.0") .. parse_ipv4("10.255.255.255") )
and parsed_dst_IP !between ( parse_ipv4("172.16.0.0") .. parse_ipv4("172.31.255.255") ) and parsed_dstnat_IP !between (parse_ipv4("192.168.0.0") .. parse_ipv4("192.168.255")) and parsed_dstnat_IP !between ( parse_ipv4("10.0.0.0") .. parse_ipv4("10.255.255.255") )
and parsed_dstnat_IP !between ( parse_ipv4("172.16.0.0") .. parse_ipv4("172.31.255.255") )
| where (DeviceVendor == "Palo Alto Networks" and Activity == "url")  
| where RequestContext !contains "text" and RequestContext !contains "image" and RequestContext !contains "javascript"
| extend RequestURL= trim_end('"',RequestURL) 
| where RequestURL endswith ".exe" or RequestURL endswith ".gz" or RequestURL endswith ".rar" or RequestURL endswith ".msi" or RequestURL endswith  ".bat" or RequestURL endswith ".dll" or RequestURL endswith ".jar" or RequestURL endswith  ".ps1" or RequestURL endswith ".zip"  or RequestURL endswith ".vba" or RequestURL endswith ".vbs"
| where DeviceCustomString2 == "NULL" or  DeviceCustomString2 == "unknown" or DeviceCustomString2 =="insufficient-content"
| extend category = DeviceCustomString2
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP
| extend URLCustomEntity = RequestURL;
let ceflogs = CommonSecurityLog1
| where TimeGenerated > ago (10m)
| where SourceIP !in (TriggeredIPs)
// Exclude Private Destination Addresses and Privated Destination Translated Addresses
| where DestinationIP !startswith "130.41.187."
| extend parsed_dst_IP = parse_ipv4(DestinationIP), parsed_dstnat_IP = parse_ipv4(DestinationTranslatedAddress)
| where parsed_dst_IP !between (parse_ipv4("192.168.0.0") .. parse_ipv4("192.168.255")) and parsed_dst_IP !between ( parse_ipv4("10.0.0.0") .. parse_ipv4("10.255.255.255") )
and parsed_dst_IP !between ( parse_ipv4("172.16.0.0") .. parse_ipv4("172.31.255.255") ) and parsed_dstnat_IP !between (parse_ipv4("192.168.0.0") .. parse_ipv4("192.168.255")) and parsed_dstnat_IP !between ( parse_ipv4("10.0.0.0") .. parse_ipv4("10.255.255.255") )
and parsed_dstnat_IP !between ( parse_ipv4("172.16.0.0") .. parse_ipv4("172.31.255.255") )
| where (DeviceVendor == "Palo Alto Networks" and DeviceEventClassID == "url")  or DeviceVendor == "Forcepoint" or DeviceVendor == "McAfee"
| where RequestContext !contains "text" and RequestContext !contains "image" and RequestContext !contains "javascript"
| extend RequestURL= trim_end('"',RequestURL)
| where RequestURL endswith ".exe" or RequestURL endswith ".gz" or RequestURL endswith ".rar" or RequestURL endswith ".msi" or RequestURL endswith  ".bat" or RequestURL endswith ".dll" or RequestURL endswith ".jar" or RequestURL endswith  ".ps1" or RequestURL endswith ".zip"  or RequestURL endswith ".vba" or RequestURL endswith ".vbs"
| where DeviceCustomString2 == "NULL" or  DeviceCustomString2 == "unknown" or DeviceCustomString2 =="insufficient-content"
| extend category = DeviceCustomString2
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP
| extend URLCustomEntity = RequestURL;

| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP

let alllogs = union isfuzzy=true  ceflogs, pasyslog, bclogs, ciscowsa, websenselogs,PrismaAccessLogs;
alllogs
